# Practice procedure: review a help article

## Purpose

Keep a fictional help article understandable without including live customer data.

## Before starting

- [ ] Confirm that this is the current article.
- [ ] Check that the reviewer can view the source material.
- [x] Use fictional examples in this practice copy.

## Steps

1. Read the article as a new teammate.
2. Compare the instructions with the agreed process.
3. Record the decision and a short reason.
4. Ask the owner to mark the page reviewed after approval.

> Do not publish private information as part of a practice review.

## Example outcome

```text
Article: Getting started
Decision: Ready for owner review
Follow-up: Clarify the escalation contact
```

## Completion

Resolve discussion threads only after the question has been answered. Keep earlier decisions in page history rather than deleting their context.
